notes.claim: A logarithm gives an exponent: the base 2 logarithm of 32 is 5 because 5 is the exponent applied to 2 to get 32.
The logarithm with base e is called the natural logarithm, written ln.

sources.title: 6.3 Logarithmic Functions - Algebra and Trigonometry 2e | OpenStax
sources.quote: For example, the base 2 logarithm of 32 is 5, because 5 is the exponent we must apply to 2 to get 32.
